content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Safwan 2's PostSafwan 26d · Shared with PublicIs There a Cut at the RBC Heritage Open 2026? Format ExplainedThe RBC Heritage 2026, the fourth Signature Event of the PGA Tour season, is underway this week at the iconic Harbour Town Golf Links in Hilton Head Island, South Carolina, with an elite 82-player field competing for a $20 million purse.Unlike traditional full-field PGA Tour events, the RBC Heritage does not have a 36-hole cut. All players in the limited field will compete over all four rounds (72 holes of stroke play), ensuring everyone earns FedExCup points and a share of the prize money — even the last-place finisher is guaranteed a payout of around $36,000 or more.This no-cut format is standard for most Signature Events (except the three player-hosted ones like the Genesis Invitational, Arnold Palmer Invitational, and Memorial Tournament, which retain cuts). It allows top stars, including defending champion Justin Thomas, Scottie Scheffler, and other major winners, to focus purely on performance without the pressure of missing the weekend.The tournament runs April 16-19, 2026, with the winner claiming 700 FedExCup points and a plaid jacket.
